dialogue.dialogue: who are you?
I'm Eshan
why are you talking in uppercase?
we don't do that here.
Well, I do!
you're generally just going against the style of this game.
that's making me unnessecarilly angry.
Yeah that's kinda the name of the expression you're using
I guess I'll have to end the dialouge now so I can get away
oh, howdy, stranger!
nice day for workin', ain't it?
too bad the weedwhacker's broke...
i can't find them darn replacement blades anywhere!
hey, if ya see 'em around, bring 'em here, see?
i'll keep an eye out.
by the way, you wouldn't happen to have seen my sweater button around, would you?
this is my favourite sweater...
sweater button? hmm, can't say i've seen it.
tell ya what, you keep an eye out for them weedwhacker blades, an' i'll keep a lookout for your button!
thanks, dude.
found anythin' yet?
nope. you found any buttons?
i didn't, but i'll keep lookin'.
thanks, i'll be on the lookout for the blades.
hey, i found your weedwhacker blades!
hey, thanks for lookin' for those!
hold on, i gotta repay you somehow.
here, take these clippers. it's not much, but it's at least somethin'.
how's the clippers?
i don't really know what to do with them, but i still appreciate the gift.
maybe if i find somethin' else, i could repay you with a better item.
no no, it's alright.
if you say so.
maybe you could try and cut some of the plants nearby, though. that could help you find what you're looking for!
thanks, i'll keep it in mind.
how's the clippers?
i actually managed to use them to find a flashlight!
glad you managed to at least do somethin' with those.
oh hey, i think i found a bag of...
uh, what is this?
oh, it's just weedwhacker blades. thought it was something else.
looks like there's a sign with directions.
it says the garden is south, the caves are east, the woods are west, and there's rosebushes north.
i've always wondered who decided to put four locations onto two arrow signs, though. maybe the points were made by accident?
that cave is looking very dark. i don't think i'd like to go inside.
how did this ball of thorns get here? looks like it's covering something.
don't have anything to cut them with, either.
hmmmm, these thorns look like they could be cut somehow...
wait, i can use the clippers i got!
oh look, a flashlight!
i think this would be useful for any dark places.
nerd find grog.
grog want fruit. far, in trees.
from the woods? that sure is far, yeah.
on yeah, have you seen my sweater button in here?
button? grog not see button.
grog have shiny. bring grog food, grog give shiny.
i don't know why i'd need that, but i guess i might as well.
nerd find grog.
nerd find fruit?
listen dude, why can't you go outside for food?
me look at sun. sun too bright.
me look at sun and say "your too bright."
that no work.
nerd find grog.
nerd find fruit?
yeah, i found an apple for you.
me have apple now. grog repays you.
thanks for the crystal, then.
(i don't know why i chose to do this...)
nerd find grog.
grog like food nerd give.
apple taste better than shiny.
yeah, glad i could get you something to eat..
oh look, an apple!
i might as well pick it up, but i don't think i can eat it.
i happen to be allergic to apples.
greetigns smol human.
i found a shiny trophy. it's mine now.
that's... not how that works, but okay.
hey, you wouldn't happen to have seen my sweater button lying around, would you?
sweater button? i have lots of buttons.
but i won't let you look at them unless you give me somethin' real shiny.
alright, guess i'll have to look for something shiny.
greetigns.
you found a shiny?
i haven't found a shiny.
find me the shiny, i want a shiny.
(i guess i need to keep looking for something shiny...)
greetigns.
whatcha got there?
a shiny crystal. looks like something you might want.
ooohhh, shiny.
gimme. this is better than some dumb trophy.
you can take it. i don't want it anymore.
... and the button collection?
you can look through that, doesn't matter to me.
this is way more shiny than buttons.
alright, let's see here...
nope, nothing that matches my sweater. i'll have to keep looking.
mmmm, yummy shiny.
... did you say yummy?
yeah, i like eating crystals. especially shiny ones.
if it's shiny but not crystal though, i don't eat it.
i only like how crystals taste. way better than things like apples.
suit yourself, then.
... that darned dragon...
huh? what about her?
i'll tell ya what! she took my favourite trophy and won't give it back!
darn, that stinks. i'll see if i can get it back, then.
by the way, have you seen my sweater button around?
huh? sweater button? no idea.
i'll look around here. you go get my trophy back!
alright, see ya.
hey, you got my trophy back yet?
nope. found a button?
i saw that dragon has a whole bunch of buttons! a slew of them!
she might have your button as well!
i did see that as well, i'll keep it in mind though.
hey, you got my trophy back yet?
yeah, turns out i just had to give the dragon a shiny crystal.
... that's it? that's all you had to do?
yeah, that's all i had to really do.
dang, i could've been able to do that the entire time.
guess i gotta repay you now, though.
don't think i found what you were looking for, but i found this watering can under a tree you might like.
(what is up with these people and giving me random items?)
you know, i've treasured this trophy for a while.
it's the first thing i've ever won, after i got first in a four legged race.
... i'm sorry, four legged race?
yeah, four legged race.
you know, where people go on all fours instead.
makes you have to work on your arms and your legs.
oh, look at these flowers! so beautiful!
they, uh, look like they need water.
oh, but the problem is, i've lost my watering can!
but don't worry! i'm learning how to do a rain dance to get water instead!
(i think i'm gonna need to find her a watering can for her own sanity.)
oh, how i miss my watering can...
but rain dancing is so fun, whether or not it brings rain!
listen, i'm gonna find your watering can, you don't need to overexert yourself.
oh, don't worry, i'm not pushing myself at all!
you're covered in sweat.
oh, i think those are actually droplets!
that must mean the rain is going to come!
okay, look, i got this watering can for you, you can have it.
oh finally, a very convenient way to bring water to plants!
... oh wait, there isn't any water in here.
(don't tell me i'll have to get the water for her...)
oh, i just wasn't looking inside! turns out it was completely full!
here, take this flower as a gift of friendship!
i love watering with a watering can!
it gives so much water to the plants!
... i just realized, i don't think those are flowers.
they look more like... big, lettuce things.
anything can be a flower if you believe hard enough!
oh, woe is me, my flower has wilted...
now, i wear it atop my head...
hey, something up?
my iconic flower has lot its spark, and so have i...
i now sit here, wondering what i shall do...
hey, don't worry, i'll get a flower for you, alright?
do not pity me, dear stranger. i am already drowning in a sea of tears, no way to float up...
hey, listen, your wordplay is pretty cool.
you sound like you could be a poet.
oh, without this flower, i am not recognized as who i was...
"reginald damarti, famous poet and occasional actor, known for the flower he wears atop his head."
oh, how things used to be...
you mean that article i read a few hours ago?
it may have felt like yesterday, but i have changed much within that eternity before and my current position...
here, i found a new flower for you.
i know it might not be able to replace what you had before, but i at least hope it helps.
... is this, by chance, a flower from flora?
uhh, yeah?
oh, then it shall be a perfect replacement!
before my fame, i had worn one of her flowers, but in the midst of popularity i had abandonned it for something more vibrant...
but, along the way, i may have lost the bond that makes her flowers special, so i will now proudly display it on my hat!
oh yeah, almost forgot to ask, have you seen a purple sweater button anywhere?
oh, why yes, i have!
was it yours, perhaps? i found it, yet didn't know who it belonged to.
yeah, that's mine's! could i have it?
why, of course! a gift from one to another!
